y-m-13-11.title: Haddii aan laba-jibbaar weyneyno, maxaa ku dhacaya wareegga iyo aagga?
y-m-13-11.topic: Xiriirka sida dhinaca laba-jibbaar iyo wareeggiisa iyo aaggiisa u beddelmaan
y-m-13-11.goal: Ku baar dhowr tusaale imisa jeer ayaa wareegga iyo aagga noqda marka dhinac noqdo tiro jeer, hel xeerka u dhexeeya jibbaarka dhinaca iyo jibbaarka aagga, oo sharax sababta.
y-m-13-11.material: Doyun wuxuu yiri, 'Haddii aad laba-jibbaar hal dhinac laabto, wareeggu wuu laabmaa aaggu na wuu laabmaa sidoo kale.' Halkan, laba-jibbaarku wuxuu leeyahay dhererka dhinac oo ah tiro dabiici ah cm, cutubka aagguna waa sentimitir labajibbaaran (cm²).
y-m-13-11.thinking.2: Sharaxaadda sababta adigoo isticmaalaya dherer iyo ballaadh
y-m-13-11.prereq.1: Helitaanka aagga afar-geesyada qummanka iyo laba-jibbaarrada (heerka fasalka 5aad)
y-m-13-11.s.s1.prompt: Laba-jibbaar dhinaciisu yahay 3cm ayaa la weyneeyey si dhinacu u noqdo 6cm. Imisa jeer asalka ayuu wareeggu iyo aaggu mid walba noqonayaan?
y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.0: Hel wareegga iyo aagga dhinac 3cm iyo dhinac 6cm oo ku qor shax.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.1: Qiimayaasha asalka ah iyo qiimayaasha ka dib weyneynta dhinac-dhinac dhig oo hel imisa jeer ayay noqdeen.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.a: Wareeggu waa 2 jeer, aaggu waa 4 jeer
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad xisaab ku xaqiijisay in marka dhinac laabmo, wareegga iyo aagga ay isbeddelaan jibbaar kala duwan.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.b: Wareeggu waa 2 jeer, aaggu waa 2 jeer sidoo kale
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa isla ereyada Doyun. Naftaada u hel aagga asalka ah 3×3 iyo aagga ka dib weyneynta 6×6 oo isbarbar dhig.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.c: Wareeggu waa 4 jeer, aaggu waa 4 jeer
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.c: Wareeggu waa isugeynta dhererrada afarta dhinac. Hel imisa cm ayuu wareeggii asalka ahaa ee 12cm noqdaa ka dib weyneynta.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.d: Wareeggu waa 2 jeer, aaggu waa 3 jeer
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.d: Aagga waxaa lagu helaa ku dhufashada dhererka iyo ballaadhka. Eeg waxa ku dhaca dhererka iyo ballaadhka marka dhinac laabmo.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.explain: Marka dhinac yahay 3cm, wareeggu waa 12cm aaggu na waa 9cm², marka dhinac yahay 6cm na, wareeggu waa 24cm aaggu na waa 36cm². Wareeggu waa 2 jeer, laakiin aaggu waa 4 jeer. 'Aaggu wuu laabmaa sidoo kale' ee Doyun sax ma aha tusaalahan.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.prompt: Aagga laba-jibbaar dhinaciisa lagu weyneeyey k jeer asalka wuxuu noqdaa m jeer aagga asalka ah. (k waa tiro dabiici ah laga bilaabo 2 ilaa 10.) Geli 3 lammaane oo sax ah oo kala duwan (k, m). Waxaad sidoo kale hubin kartaa adigoo naftaada u helaya aagga laba-jibbaarka.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.hint.0: Si kala horreyn ah u qor aagagga laba-jibbaarrada dhinacyadoodu yihiin 1cm, 2cm, 3cm, 4cm oo hel imisa jeer ayay mid walba noqdeen.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.hint.1: Shax ku qor jibbaarka aagga marka dhinac yahay 2 jeer iyo 3 jeer, oo hel xiriirka u dhexeeya labada jibbaar.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.var.k: Imisa jeer asalka ayuu dhinacu yahay
y-m-13-11.s.s2.var.m: Imisa jeer ayay noqotaa aagga asalka ah
y-m-13-11.s.s2.ok.c1: k waa tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 2 ilaa 10.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.fail.c1: k waa inuu noqdaa tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 2 ilaa 10.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Marka dhinac uu yahay k jeer, aagga oo m jeer ah waa sax.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Marka dhinac uu yahay k jeer, aagga ma aha m jeer. Naftaada ku hubi xisaabin.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.explain: Haddii dhinac uu yahay 2 jeer, aagga waa 4 jeer; haddii 3 jeer, 9 jeer; haddii 4 jeer, 16 jeer; haddii 5 jeer, 25 jeer. Marka dhinac uu noqdo k jeer, dhererka iyo ballaadhku labaduba waxay noqdaan k jeer, sidaas darteed aagga wuxuu noqdaa k×k jeer. Wareegga wuxuu noqdaa k jeer oo keliya.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.prompt: Qor sharciga erayo imisa jeer ayuu aagga noqdaa marka dhinac uu noqdo k jeer, oo sharax sababta adigoo isticmaalaya dhererka iyo ballaadhka.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Marka hore qor imisa jeer ayay dhererka iyo ballaadhku noqdaan marka dhinac uu yahay 2 jeer.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isticmaal xaqiiqda ah ku dhufashada jeer-dhererka iyo jeer-ballaadhka waxay siinaysaa jeer-aagga.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in sharcigaagu ku habboon yahay jeerarka aagga ee 2 jeer iyo 3 jeer labadaba?
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Sababta ah dhererka iyo ballaadhka labaduba waa koraan ma ku xidhan tahay sharciga?
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Marka dhinac uu noqdo k jeer, aagga wuxuu noqdaa k×k jeer. Dhererku wuxuu noqdaa k jeer ballaadhkuna wuxuu noqdaa k jeer sidoo kale, sidaas darteed waxaad ku dhufataa isla tiro laba jeer.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Marka dhinac uu noqdo 3 jeer, aagga wuxuu noqdaa 3×3=9 jeer. Dhererku wuxuu noqdaa 3 jeer ballaadhkuna wuxuu noqdaa 3 jeer sidoo kale, sidaas darteed waxaad ku dhufataa 3 laba jeer.

y-m-13-03.title: Haddii aad geliso qaansooyin, ma natiijadu hubaal ayay isbeddeshaa?
y-m-13-03.topic: Xisaab isku dhafan oo tirooyin dabiici ah: qaansooyinka iyo nidaamka xisaabinta
y-m-13-03.goal: Tijaabi sheegashada 'gelidda qaansooyin mar walba waxay beddeshaa', naftaada hel tusaale lid ku ah, oo sharax shuruudda natiijadu ku sii ahaanayso isku mid.
y-m-13-03.material: Jiho wuxuu yiri, 'Haddii aad geliso qaansooyin odhaah, natiijadu mar walba way isbeddeshaa.' Sua wuxuu ku jawaabay, 'Runtii mar walba sidaas ma tahay? Waxaan u maleynayaa inay jiraan kiisas aan isbeddelin.' Labadu waxay go'aamiyeen inay barbar dhigaan laba odhaah adigoo isticmaalaya saddex lambar a, b, c. Odhaahda ㉮ waa a + b × c (a ku dar b jeer c), odhaahda ㉯ na waa (a + b) × c (marka hore xisaabi a ku dar b, ka dibna ku dhufo c). Saddexda lambar dhammaantood waa tirooyin dabiici ah oo 1 ama ka badan, waxayna raacaan heshiiska ah ku dhufashada waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa ka hor ku darista.
y-m-13-03.thinking.0: Fahamka in hal tusaale uu go'aamin karin 'mar walba'
y-m-13-03.thinking.2: Sheegidda shuruudda ay run tahay waxa tusaalayaashu wadaagaan
y-m-13-03.prereq.0: Heshiiska ah in ku dhufashada marka hore la xisaabiyo odhaah isku dhafan ku darista iyo ku dhufashada
y-m-13-03.prereq.1: Heshiiska ah in gudaha qaansooyinka marka hore la xisaabiyo marka ay jiraan qaansooyin
y-m-13-03.s.s1.prompt: Marka a=2, b=3, c=4, ㉮ waa 2 + 3 × 4 = 14 ㉯ na waa (2 + 3) × 4 = 20. Maxaad ka odhan kartaa erayada labada qof hal tusaale?
y-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir haddii 14 iyo 20 ay muujinayaan erayada Jiho ama erayada Sua.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir nooca tusaale aad u baahan tahay si aad u muujiso 'mar walba sidaas' inuu khaldan yahay.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.a: Hal mar ayay isbeddeshay, sidaas darteed waan hubaa erayada Jiho waa sax saddex lambar kasta.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad hal tusaale u ballaadhisay dhammaan kiisaska. Si aad u hubiso 'mar walba', waxaad u baahan tahay inaad eegto dhammaan set-yada saddex lambar.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.b: Qaansooyinku saameyn ma leh natiijada, sidaas darteed erayada Sua waa sax erayada Jiho na waa khalad.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.b: Hadda waxaad aragtay tusaalaha isbeddelay 14 iyo 20. Eeg haddii tani ka soo horjeedo tusaalahaas.

y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.d: Waad ogtahay in hal tusaale ka soo horjeeda loo baahan yahay si loo jebiyo 'mar walba.'
y-m-13-03.s.s1.explain: Hal tusaale ma hubin karo 'mar walba'. Haddii erayada Sua ay sax yihiin waa la xaqiijiyaa haddii aad hesho xitaa hal set oo saddex lambar ah halka qiimayaasha labada odhaah ay siman yihiin. Si ka duwan, si loo caddeeyo erayada Jiho, waa inaad eegtaa dhammaan set-yada saddex lambar.
y-m-13-03.s.s2.prompt: Hubi bayaanka Sua. Hel saddex lambar (a, b, c) oo a + b × c iyo (a + b) × c ay leeyihiin isla qiime, oo gali.
